title: release cutover checklist - daily scratchpad
content:
Objective: quick daily scratchpad for release day cutover tasks and notes. Personal running TODOs + comms + backports. Not intended as final runbook; capture what I actually do and any follow-ups.

TIMELINE (local PT)
- 09:00 - pre-cutover sync (15m) with oncall + SRE + infra
  - agenda: confirm window, failover plan, DB migration readiness, cache invalidation script tested
- 09:30 - freeze: block merges to main, post notice in #releases and #eng-alerts
- 10:00 - start canary traffic to v2 (20%)
- 10:30 - evaluate metrics; if OK ramp to 50%
- 11:00 - ramp to 100% and finish cutover tasks
- 12:00 - post-cutover check + wrap

CHECKLIST (quick)
- [ ] final cherry-picks/backports applied (list below)
- [ ] db-migrations: run in staging, smoke tests green, then prod during window
- [ ] config roll (feature flags) toggled to new variant (ff-release-2026-03-04)
- [ ] cache invalidation jobs queued for 10:15 PT
- [ ] traffic routing/policy updated (nginx + routing-service)
- [ ] alert thresholds adjusted for higher QPS (temp)
- [ ] monitoring dashboards snapshot saved (Dashboard: Release/Cutover/2026-03-04)
- [ ] comms: #releases pinned message + email to stakeholders
- [ ] rollback procedure documented in this doc and pinged to oncall

BACKPORT / CHERRY-PICK NOTES
- must backport the following PRs into release branch before freeze:
  - PR#1203: fix kv-cache mem leak (cherry-pick commit a4f3d2) -- Jordan owns
  - PR#1210: nginx header pass-through edge case (commit 7b2c1e) -- Marcus to apply
  - PR#1218: logging level tweak for model-loader (no schema changes) -- small, can go after freeze if needed

Commands I ran / plan to run (copy-paste friendly)
- git checkout release/2026-03-04 && git cherry-pick a4f3d2 7b2c1e
- ./scripts/db/migrate --env=prod --dry-run && ./scripts/db/migrate --env=prod --apply --tag=cutover-2026-03-04
- kubectl rollout status deployment/model-serving -n prod --watch
- ./infra/cache/invalidate --prefix=kv-cache-v1 --when=2026-03-04T10:15:00-07:00

METRICS TO WATCH (first 30m after ramp)
- p95 latency (text-gen endpoint): target < 220ms
- token/sec throughput and qps per instance (watch for tail lat spikes)
- error rate (5xx) and concrete failure types: kv-cache OOM, model-initialization timeouts
- cost spike (auto-alert if > 2x baseline)

COMMS TEMPLATE (quick)
- Pre-freeze (post to #releases): "Cutover window starts 10:00 PT. Freezing merges to main at 09:30 PT. Expect short instability during ramp. Contact @oncall-release for urgent issues."
- Post-cutover: "Cutover to release/2026-03-04 complete at HH:MM PT. Observability checks green/seeing X. Rollback window until HH:MM PT (1h). See playbook: confluence://release/playbook#cutover-checklist"

ROLLBACK (if needed)
- Immediate: flip traffic back to previous model version (routing-service cmd)
- If config rollback: re-enable ff old flag ff-release-previous via flags-service
- DB rollback: avoid if possible; use compensating migration if necessary. Notify DB team immediately.

OPEN QUESTIONS / TODOs (post-mortem follow-ups)
- Who will own follow-up for the KV cache OOM if it reoccurs? (ask infra)
- Need better smoke-test script that hits a few long-tail prompts (file an issue: JIRA-RELEASE-1741)
- Add automated step to snapshot current infra autoscaler settings prior to roll (ticket created?)

NOTES TO SELF (quick)
- remember to escalate to SRE lead before doing full 100% ramp if p95 > 300ms or error rate > 0.5%
- double-check feature flag rollout ordering (DB migration MUST be applied before toggling ff)
- keep an eye on costs: dedicated pool usage can spike during canary

RECENT ACTIVITY (log)
- 08:42 - PR#1203 cherry-picked locally; ran unit tests (failures unrelated, infra mocks).
- 08:55 - messaged Jordan + Marcus to confirm backports; Jordan acked.
- 09:05 - pre-cutover checklist draft posted to #releases for last-minute notes.

REFERENCES
- Cutover playbook (confluence): confluence://release/playbook#cutover-checklist
- Release branch: git@github.com:redwood-inference/release/2026-03-04
- Runbook for model-serving rollback: /docs/runbooks/model-serving-rollback.md

End of scratchpad. Update this during the day with timestamps.
